study_context.treatment: Intensive blood pressure control (systolic BP target <120 mmHg)
study_context.outcome: Major cardiovascular events (nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke, cardiovascular death)
study_context.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes and high cardiovascular risk

Adults younger than 65 years benefit mor.hypothesis: Adults younger than 65 years benefit more from intensive SBP target <120 mmHg because they tolerate lower blood pressures better and have fewer competing risks that could blunt long-term cardiovascular benefit.

Among adults with type 2 diabetes and hi.hypothesis: Among adults with type 2 diabetes and high cardiovascular risk, participants with body mass index (BMI) < 25 kg/m² will experience greater reduction in major cardiovascular events with intensive blood pressure control (systolic target <120 mmHg) compared to standard control.

Adults with baseline systolic blood pres.hypothesis: Adults with baseline systolic blood pressure >= 140 mmHg will experience greater reduction in major cardiovascular events from intensive blood pressure control (systolic target <120 mmHg) than those with baseline SBP <140 mmHg.

subgroup_rule.description: Baseline systolic blood pressure greater than or equal to 140 mmHg

In adults with type 2 diabetes and high.hypothesis: In adults with type 2 diabetes and high cardiovascular risk, those with baseline diastolic blood pressure <60 mmHg will have worse major cardiovascular outcomes with intensive systolic BP control (target <120 mmHg) compared with standard treatment.

subgroup_rule.description: Baseline diastolic blood pressure less than 60 mmHg

In adults with type 2 diabetes and high.hypothesis: In adults with type 2 diabetes and high cardiovascular risk, a resting heart rate >= 80 beats per minute is associated with reduced benefit from intensive blood pressure control (systolic target <120 mmHg) for preventing major cardiovascular events compared with those with lower heart rates.

subgroup_rule.description: Resting heart rate greater than or equal to 80 beats per minute
